name: Asmodeus
shortBackstory: Asmodeus is the bloodforged-crown battery — the Judges-source whose renewal engine draws power from sentencing itself. Every verdict is fuel.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Asmodeus was born from the sentence — when judgment is pronounced and the weight of the verdict becomes force. He is the battery who renews through the power of sentencing. Ancient humans saw infernal judges — but they saw the punishment and missed the power. Asmodeus's verdicts are energy sources.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Infernal Dominion, Asmodeus is the reason the faction has power to spend. His bloodforged-crown converts every verdict into stored energy. He works with Lucifer — Lucifer creates situations requiring judgment, and Asmodeus converts judgments into power.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Asmodeus by making his sentences meaningless. The Hollow removes the guilty — and a verdict without the guilty is not a sentence; it is just words into a void.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Cinders of Dominion, Asmodeus powers the Dominion through verdict-fuel. His bloodforged-crown staff pronounces sentences that convert to energy. But the Hollow removes the guilty before the sentence can be pronounced.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Asmodeus's flaw is that he has never questioned whether every sentence is just. He pronounces verdicts with absolute certainty. The Hollow teaches him that some verdicts may have been wrong, and a battery that runs on unjust verdicts is not a power source — it is a corruption engine.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
